ownership: Extend existing application identity/context, opaque session issuer, conversation journals and next-run owner; Fable owns runtime. No second API stack, issuer or scheduler.

scalars.sha256: lowercase64hex canonical existing serializer hash; not authority
scalars.cursor: null or opaque integrity-protected string, max4096; codec owner not allocated
scalars.nativeCredential: existing native bridge authentication, never a DTO field

required.expiresAtMs: time > release time, bounded by current receipts

required.bindingSha256: sha256 of exact server-loaded complete RunBinding
required.completionReceiptSha256: sha256 of exact published immutable completion proof

required.bindingSha256: sha256 of full original server target binding

required.commandSha256: sha256 over full canonical prepare input
required.source: source iff next-turn, null iff new-conversation
required.admissionSha256: sha256 of exact durable original admission association
required.originalTargetExpiresAtMs: time fixed by original target admission
required.recordedAtMs: trusted durable receipt time <= trusted current observation
required.receiptSha256: sha256 of receipt excluding this field

required.sequenceBase: safe integer >=0 from existing run sequence owner
required.sourceRunId: uuid or null; disclose only if currently authorized

required.allowedOperations: closed subset of existing submit/history/cancel/events/reconnect; observe excludes submit/cancel
required.expiresAtMs: time bounded by session/current facts and by original target expiry for effects
required.submitConstraint: null for observe; first-input for first-submit; original requestId+inputSha256 for same-submit

required.reason: valid-target | target-expired | target-not-current | target-terminal | original-input-required | payload-unavailable

discoverConversations.effect: read only; no selection, reservation, session issue or dispatch

required.querySha256: sha256 of canonical query and traversal context
required.coverage: more iff nextCursor non-null; complete iff null

discoverConversations.pageRule: Reauthorize every page/row. Invalid/stale context refuses. Zero-visible more is not empty. Explicit retry may repeat same page; client deduplicates page input/output cursor and refuses cycles. Failure emits no partial page or fake complete.

openConversation.effect: existing issuer only; no conversation/run/task/grant allocation, mutation, submit, dispatch or cancel

required.admissionReference: null iff observe; exact immutable reference iff admitted-target
required.retainedSubmit: null or closed {requestId,inputSha256}; original browser bytes retained separately, not sent in open

crossFields: observe yields observe only, never submit/cancel
admitted-target requires fresh exact immutable command/target mapping and original deadline
durably unused current target may yield first-submit
existing/unknown target input yields same-submit only with original input identity/bytes
inaccessible and nonexistent pair both denied with no metadata
client-only compatibility bootstrap can only selection-required or read-only existing pair, never reserve

prepareConversationTurn.effect: existing admission/next-run owner only; no prompt acceptance/model/dispatch

required.intent: closed tagged new-conversation with source:null OR next-turn with source:source

required.projection: sessionProjection with first-submit or same-submit only

precedence: Existing same-command exact bytes -> immutable mapping first; changed bytes -> conflict
Only new command tests latest completed source and current checkpoint/retirement/revocation
Compute current effect/read eligibility separately; stale historical receipt never prepared
prepareConversationTurn.durabilityGap: f0 next_runs does not bind public commandId/hash; initial process-local issuer has no general durable creation command map. Existing owner extension/design and any separate allocation required before implementation.

lookupConversationTurn.effect: read only, no session issue or allocation/reserve/dispatch
lookupConversationTurn.input: exact original prepare commandId/hash/client/intent/source; no new ID
lookupConversationTurn.freshness: Fresh current authority permits only exact retained receipt; reopen-target is a hint to explicit open+recheck, never a write grant.

required.lookupWitnessSha256: authoritative durable identity lookup proof; not generic404

required.code: invalid-input | denied | cursor-invalid | cursor-stale | unavailable | deadline

invariants: All alternatives closed: fields from other variants forbidden. No empty-on-error or hidden total.
Lookup/recorded never includes session, credential or allowedOperations containing submit.
prepared requires currently authorized effect-eligible target and original deadline; not merely historical admitted receipt.
Open/session exact pair + projection target must equal immutable association; mismatch refuses.
Current revocation/suppression forbidding receipt returns denied without receipt/source/target.
Expiry/purge cannot remint; receipt-only may be returned only when current retention owner permits control metadata.
Continuation ACK and target initial-submit ACK remain separate identities/receipts.
Original full source and target RunBindings remain server-trusted; browser fields are selectors only.
Source-completed is insufficient: published checkpoint, physical task retirement and complete grant revocation precede successor admission.
next-turn is not resume/fork; no old prompt replay, new grant, worker expiry renewal or automatic retry.
Immutable receipt outcome + current eligibility are separate; exact same-command recovery precedes a new-command latest-source test.
No capability or wire accepted by these design JSON bytes.
